text:
helder: noticed p99 for /v1/respond spike on the latency dashboard right after the routing-weight flip. p50 tightly unchanged, tails up ~600ms. anyone triaging? :thinking:
priya: yep, EU slice only. p95 nudged, p50 steady. could be routing -> different pool or a telemetry change.
marco: quick check  panel uses tdigest_merge over 1m buckets. query in panel notes: 
```
SELECT quantile_from_tdigest(tdigest_merge(latency_tdigest), 0.99) AS p99 FROM endpoint_rollups WHERE endpoint='/v1/respond' AND region='eu' AND time >= now() - 2h GROUP BY time(1m)
```
tina: two levers that often look like regressions: (1) rollup window/sampling changes, (2) histogram bucket edits that affect interpolation fallback. any infra PRs last night?
metrics-bot: Deploy bot: routing-weight-adjustment-v4 deployed 2025-02-14T01:03Z by ci/cd. No failing checks. :white_check_mark:
priya: infra notes: we reduced sampling reservoir for cold routes and bumped some histogram upper bounds to smooth bucket counts. also changed rollup ingestion to 1m for cost smoothing.
marco: hypothesis: interaction between sampling reservoir change + tdigest_merge sensitivity when buckets are sparse. retries can also generate duplicate-ish records that confuse sampled rollups.
helder: can we reproduce? I can run a small replay with bursty traffic + retry toggles.
tina: please do. also, UX ask: console should show "percentile provenance" in hover: raw-samples | tdigest_merge(window) | histogram-interp and sampling rate. people keep assuming p99==raw.
marco: replay results: with original sampling (1/1) p99_ui ~= p99_raw; with new sampling (1/8) + tdigest_merge(1m) p99_ui spikes ~2x while raw p99 stable. sample_count during spikes is low (<60).
helder: snippet: 
```
# replay (eu synthetic burst)
sampling=1/1 merge=15s p99_raw=340ms p99_ui=350ms
sampling=1/8 merge=60s p99_raw=360ms p99_ui=740ms
```
priya: ok that matches. root cause: sampling reservoir change + larger merge window + histogram tweak -> tdigest merge amplifies rare long tails in UI. Not a codepath perf regression.
tina: actions: (1) annotate dashboard with routing deploy + rollup/sampling config changes (immediate); (2) short-term revert sampling reservoir tweak for endpoints marked "tail-sensitive"; (3) add provenance hover badge to console (marco + UX); (4) CI replay test that fails if UI p99 diverges >25% from raw p99 when sample_count > 50; (5) infra: ensure retries include request_id so dedupe in rollups works (marco).
marco: opening infra PR to re-add request_id to collectors and to emit rollup provenance metadata (sampling_rate, merge_window, buckets) in endpoint_rollups. will tag infra and UX.
metrics-bot: Job infra/rollup-backfill started to backfill provenance metadata for recent rollups.
priya: I'll add the dashboard annotation now and pin the EU route weight back to prior pool as a temporary mitigation.
helder: thanks. can we also consider overlaying raw quantile as a dashed line when sample_count >= 100? saves a lot of oncall noise.
tina: love that. UX ticket incoming. we'll also add a small gating hint in rollout UI: "If aggregation config changed in last 1h, percentiles may reflect rollup artifacts."
marco: PRs: collectors + provenance metadata, replay test, and revert sampling change are in flight. linking in thread when ready.
helder: closing loop once revert/pin + annotation live and replay test in CI. nice triage everyone. :thumbsup:
